notes.title: 🌍 New Languages + Map Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks to community feedback, we’ve rolled out another small update.

What’s new:

• Fixed some map-related bugs reported by Agusio on Discord ! 
• Added full German language support thanks to Marcel Weyers
• Added Russian language support
• Fixed general bugs and improved stability
 

Let us know if you notice anything off in the new language translations or maps!


We’re also actively looking into other issues that were reported, such as game crashes and rare cases of corrupted saves. Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: Improved Local Co-Op Option, Chinese language Fixes & Discord QR Update
notes.content:
What’s new:

• Added a checkbox in the settings to enable local multiplayer using Keyboard/Mouse + Controller → (See image below for updated controls) 
• Fixed an issue where Chinese characters would disappear 
• Updated default settings to launch the game in 120 FPS & high quality 
• Fixed the QR code not appearing in the main menu → Now links directly to our Discord server upon clicking.
• Small collision bug fixes


Thanks again for playing Wires and Whiskers and for all your feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Wires and Whiskers is Out Now!
notes.content:
Wires and Whiskers is officially out! 🐭⚡


▶️ \[Play now]

In this fast-paced 2-player local co-op game, one of you plays a cyber lab gerbil and the other, its armed exosuit. You’ll have to coordinate movement, attacks, and magnetic powers to survive an irradiated world of hostile machines.




- Couch co-op or Steam Remote Play Together support

- Dynamic mix of 2.5D navigation and top-down combat

- Two unique roles: agile melee vs. ranged magnetic powers

- Mutant enemies, tight puzzles, and smart coordination

- Playable in ~30 minutes — ideal for a quick, tactical session!

🎮 Controller Required: One player must use a controller, the other can use keyboard & mouse (or  preferably another controller). Keyboard-only support is possible for the gerbil character only, but not recommended.  


💬 Feedback or bugs?   Scan the QR code in the main menu or  join our discord Link : (https://discord.gg/EWXjvBXqYz)!

notes.title: Checkpoint & Respawn System Fix
notes.content:
We've fixed a critical issue affecting progression!


 What’s fixed:

Resolved a bug where players would respawn at the wrong location after dying or reloading a checkpoint

Save and checkpoint logic has been fully reworked to ensure consistent and fair placement

This should prevent frustrating restarts and let you get back into the action smoothly!

Let us know on Discord if you notice anything odd still happening after respawning.

notes.title: Update – Localization Support, Checkpoint Saves
notes.content:
We’ve released a small update to improve usability and accessibility!
---
 🈯 Localization Menu
- Players can now switch between supported languages

- Language changes apply immediately without restart


💾 Checkpoint Saves (New)
- Game now saves progress at key checkpoints

- If you quit or fail, you’ll restart from your last checkpoint

- Helps streamline retry flow without losing full progress


🔧 Other Tweaks
- Minor improvements to settings UI

- Small performance optimizations





Let us know on Discord if you notice any bugs or have feedback about the new systems!

notes.title: Minor Update – QR Menu, Remote Play Improvements, A/D Support
notes.content:
We’ve pushed a small update based on your feedback!
What’s new:
- Added a **QR code** on the main menu for quick Discord access

- Improved **Steam Remote Play Together** support (more reliable controller detection)

- You can now use **A/D keys** to switch characters on the selection screen (for keyboard users)



Note: Keyboard play is still designed around a single player using **mouse + keyboard**, but A/D now gives you more flexibility if you still want to use only the keyboard.


Fixes & Optimizations:
- Fixed various minor bugs

- Optimized main menu performance
